text: The Hive runs as its own docker compose project (`hive`) with its own Postgres volume, separate from ASF's stack.
ASF's uninstall script finds containers and volumes by label, so the Hive must never share ASF's Postgres.
Postgres for the Hive is exposed on host port 5544 because ASF's Postgres already uses 5432.
Meaning search uses Ollama's nomic-embed-text model running natively on the host, producing 768-dimension vectors.
Keyword search must keep working when Ollama is down; un-embedded facts are still findable by keyword.
The hot path (recall, search) makes no LLM calls; only a local query embedding of about 5 ms.
Distillation of facts from sessions runs through `hermes -z --usage-file` on Jon's Claude subscription so every token is logged.
Every LLM or embedding call the Hive makes is written to the llm_calls table with tokens and estimated cost.
Jon is the sole curator in the MVP: shared-scope candidates need his approval before other assistants use them.
Facts written by a curator into shared scope are active immediately and logged as a self-approve review.
Personal-scope facts are active immediately and are never visible to other users.
Facts have one of three origins: authored by a person, distilled from a session, or ingested from a repo or record.
Ingested facts are ground truth: active immediately and retracted automatically if their source disappears.
A fact's identity is a hash of its normalised text plus scope, so remembering the same statement twice dedupes.
Retracted and superseded facts are kept as history; nothing is deleted.
Instance tokens are stored only as sha256 hashes and can be revoked by setting revoked_at.
Each Hermes instance connects with HIVE_URL and HIVE_TOKEN via the `hive` memory-provider plugin.
The Hermes plugin lives at plugins/hive because Hermes uses the plugin directory name as the provider name.
Hermes' own venv has no pytest and must not be modified; scripts/test-plugin.sh builds a side venv instead.
The plugin is tested in CI against hermes-agent pinned at HERMES_REF; bumping it is a deliberate change.
The experiment corpus for the token-savings test is the ASF repo, its docs, and Jon's past Hermes sessions on it.
The MVP's success measure is tokens saved per question minus the Hive's own background spend, measured with Hive on vs off.
Code graph features (symbol references, impact analysis) are out of the MVP; file-level locus only.
Entire Graph, which is MIT licensed, is the preferred way to add code-graph features later instead of writing a parser.
Recall returns at most 10 active facts by default, fused from keyword and meaning results with reciprocal rank fusion.
Meaning hits below the cosine similarity floor HIVE_VECTOR_MIN_SIM are dropped so unrelated facts never pad a recall.
Keyword search ORs the words of a question so natural questions match facts containing only some of the words.
Searching conversations and session history only returns the caller's own episodes in the MVP.
Non-code documents under docs/ (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown) are ingested in milestone M3.
Jon's PR style is linear history: one branch per change off main, rebased and squash-merged.
